description: Seismic Surveys, Australia (2015) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by CSIRO Marine and Amospheric Research. This data set is a summary of seismic survey transects from 1961 to 2015. The data was summarised to 0. 1 deg grids and the number of km of the grid surveyed over a 5 year period was calculated. Geoscience Australia is releasing its 2014 version of the Marine Seismic Surveys Shape and Kml files. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher CSIRO Marine and Amospheric Research. Its tags are Natural Resources, Oceans, Petroleum, Solid Earth. It offers 17 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
